title: Create Annotation
description: Creates an annotation with the specified details.

start_time.description: Optional. The annotation's start time represented in ISO 8601 format. If not provided, the current Fullstory server time will be used.

end_time.description: Optional. The annotation's end time represented in ISO 8601 format. If not provided, it will be set to the annotation's start_time. If provided, must be after start_time.

source.description: Optional. A string representing the source or creator of this annotation, which will be displayed on the annotation's visualization.

start_time.description: The annotation's start time represented in ISO 8601 format. If this was not set in the request, it will be set to Fullstory's server time.

end_time.description: The annotation's end time represented in ISO 8601 format. If this was not set in the request, it will be set the start_time field.

response.description: Server response for creating an annotation.
